sources.quote: HAT-P-12, also named Komondor, is a magnitude 13 low-metallicity K dwarf star approximately 463 light years away in the constellation Canes Venatici, which hosts one known exoplanet.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Hartman et al. 2009.
